# Datamining: PTS Patch 68 Atom Shop Items (04/24/2026)

This PTS data mining from the PTS version of April 24th, 2026 contains Atom Shop items that are expected to be released from patch 68 with season 25. Changes are possible at any time.

## Sir Loin Collectron

**Interval**: 9 minutes

- **100% Chance**: Mongrel Dog Meat, Mole Rat Meat, Squirrel Bites, RAD Deer Meat, Pepper Grinder, Salt Shaker, Saucepan, Table Knife, Ladle, Dinner Plate, Dinner Fork, Table Spoon, Kitchen Scales, Bowl, Coaster
- **11% Chance**: Mirelurk Meat, Yao Guai Meat, Stingwing Meat, RAD Scorpion Meat, Angler Meat
- **1% Chance**: Deathclaw Egg, Mega Sloth Meat, Mirelurk Queen Meat, Scorchbeast Meat, Scorchbeast Heart, Scorchbeast Liver, Scorchbeast Lung, Sheepsquatch Meat
